Welcome to this episode where Aastha Khurana uncovers some important RBI-related insights around home loans that most people don’t realise until it’s too late. Starting with a real-life situation, we explore how certain “mandatory” steps during the loan process may not be what they seem. If you’re planning to take a home loan or already have one, this video will help you ask better questions and make more informed decisions before signing anything.
